events.title: Administrative Stay in PG Publishing Co., Inc. v. National Labor Relations Board
events.summary: The Supreme Court, through Associate Justice Samuel A. Alito, Jr., issued an administrative stay on the orders from the United States Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit dated March 24, 2025, and November 10, 2025, in case numbers 24-2788 and 24-3057. This stay is pending further order from the Court or Justice Alito. Additionally, a response to the application is required to be filed by January 5, 2026, by 5 p.m. EST.
events.why_relevant: The administrative stay temporarily halts the enforcement of lower court orders, affecting the ongoing legal proceedings.
